about: The seventeen treatments the audit looks for (sixteen from the design plus shape_damage), what each one is in plain words, which of the person's words it covers, which verb makes it, where the audit reads it, and how a smaller model might skip it and what stops that. made_by names a function (check-presets reads the file and finds it); tested_by names a test file and a phrase the test prints.

normal_map.plain: a real normal map (small bumps and dents) on the surface, pointing the right way
normal_map.skip_and_stop: bump only, a flipped green channel or an sRGB map: the audit reads the wiring and the direction test

displacement.plain: real displacement of the surface where the role says (roads, mud, thatch, rock ground), on a dense mesh
displacement.skip_and_stop: a Displacement node on a flat plane or with Bump Only: the audit reads method, depth and mesh density

roughness_variation.plain: roughness that changes across the surface (not one number)
roughness_variation.skip_and_stop: a constant roughness is read from the Principled node and fails

colour_variation.plain: colour that changes across the surface and from object to object

bevelled_edges.plain: edges that are rounded a little (a razor-sharp box edge reads as a computer model)

dirt.plain: dirt: soil film, mud splash at wall feet, dust, polish on worn ground
dirt.skip_and_stop: a layer with amount 0 or a missing pk_dirt_amount fails

grime.plain: grime: soot, run-off streaks, damp bands, stains

weathering.plain: weathering: silvering of timber, sun fade, bleaching, patina

wetness.plain: wetness: darker, smoother, puddles by depth; dry, damp or wet by state
wetness.checked_by: as dirt (amount 0 is allowed when the state is dry)

cracks_and_chips.plain: cracks and chips painted into the surface (and bump)

edge_wear.plain: edge wear: pale rubbed edges and worn corners

moss_and_algae.plain: moss and algae where it is damp and shady, never on trodden or kept-clear ground
moss_and_algae.skip_and_stop: as dirt; indoors it is allowed off with a reason

rust.plain: rust on iron: height bands, collars at joins, runs below

rubbish.plain: rubbish: muck and litter marks at gutters, wall feet and road edges, never on the crown

plants.plain: weeds, tufts, ferns, nettles and moss cushions as small 3D pieces, grown by site (wall feet, verges, fence lines, joints, damp corners, a thin background), off the wheel tracks and out of puddles
plants.checked_by: scatter.groups[] counts and keep-out counts; scatter.sites (the share of the plants in each site)
plants.skip_and_stop: the audit counts pieces per 100 square metres and the roots inside keep-out (must be 0)

litter_pieces.plain: leaves, sticks, straw, pine needles, clods as small 3D pieces, gathered at wall feet, verges and fence lines; pebbles and stones seated in unpaved ground

shape_damage.plain: damage as SHAPE: boards that bow, corners that chip, no two parts alike (what read at film size in the garden)
shape_damage.applies_to: timber, roof, stone (wanted for wall, prop)
shape_damage.skip_and_stop: the audit lists siblings of one role that are exact copies

object_checks.uv: an object under a normal-mapped material has a UV layer and few mirrored faces
object_checks.carried: the part is carried from the ground up (construction check)
object_checks.scale_ok: the size fits the real-world facts table
